newsitem.title: USA: Interneuron to resell 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Interneuron to resell 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: Interneuron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday it intends to resell 1.5 million shares and has filed a form S-3 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The resale, by certain stockholders, includes 500,000 shares issuable upon the exercise of warrants held by one stockholder, the company said.
The shares and warrants were issued in a private placement in July 1995. The shares are being registered pursuant to contractual registration rights held by such stockholders, the company said.
